programs.desc: Host Johanna Griggs, with the help of the team - Patrick Thompson, Candy Day, Will Dangar, Luke Dyer and Jason Hodges - give a faded Queenslander a king-size makeover. The team start work building a new laundry complete with a tuck-away washing machine and sink. A half-renovated bathroom is completed with gleaming new fittings and new white tiles. A lush tropical garden is created, and with new pavers, the tired old path has made way for a spectacular, inviting entranceway.
